s: Din besamim lehabdala ubo t' seipim: hinhigu chakamim lehariach bibsamim bekol motzae shabbat, kede lehashib et hannepesh shehi doebet litziat hashshabbat bishbil hanneshama yetera shehaleka, lepikak meyashshebim umesammechin otah bereach tob. Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheyyesh lo besamim, azay hu tzarik lehariach bahem. Abal im en lo — en tzarik lechazzer acharehem kederek shemmechazzerim achar hammitzvot, hoil veenam ella bishbil lehashib et hannepesh:

Mi shemmitanneh beshabbat — tzarik lebarek al habbesamim bemotzae shabbat, shekkevan shebbat hanneshama yetera belel shabbat — enah holeket ad motzae shabbat. Veim chal yom hakkippurim beshabbat — yitbaer besimman trk"d:

Kol habbesamim shennitbaer besimman ry"z sheen mebarekim alehem birkat hareach, ben mechamat issur erva o aboda zara, uben mippene sheenah asuya bishbil lehariach bahem, im heriach bahem bemotzae shabbat, ben shebberak ben shello berak — lo yatza, vetzarik lachazor ulehariach bibsamim acherim im yesh lo ulebarek alehem. Abal kol reach shemmebarekim alayv, ap im eno min bosem ella peri haomed laakila sherecho tob — yakol lehariach bo bemotzae shabbat, vibarek "hannoten reach tob bapperot". Veim hu min bosem — yebarek beraka hareuya lo, im hu min etz — "bore atze besamim". Veim hu min eseb — "bore isbe besamim". Veim eno lo min etz velo min eseb, kegon hammor (sheqqorin pizu"m) — yebarek "bore mine besamim". Vehaolam nahagu lebarek bemotzae shabbat "bore mine besamim" al kol hamminim sheyyihyu, lepi sheen hakkol beqiim bibrakot — nahagu lebarek beraka sheyyotzeim bah bediabad al kol hamminim. Umikkol maqom, tob lehanniach chatikat mor betok mine rechot shemmebarekim alehem "bore mine besamim", kede sheyyebarek birkat "bore mine besamim" kehilkatah:
Pilpelim ketushim vezangebel katush im mebarekim alehem bemotzae shabbat — nitbaer besimman ry"v:

Saqqim meleim besamim shemmesimim hannokrim tok qanqanne hayyayin kede sheyyiqlot hayyayin recham, ap al pi shemmuttar lehariach bibsamim ellu, veen bahem issur mishshum reach hayyayin shennibla bahem, hoil vehammeriach bahem eno mekavven lereach hayyayin shennibla bahem ella lereach atzmah, mikkol maqom bemotzae shabbat en littelam libsamim shel habdala lekattechilla, mippene shehem meusim laggaboah lekol debar mitzva, mechamat yayin haasur habbalua bahem:

Yesh omerim shemmitzva lebarek bemotzae shabbat al hadas shel mitzva, shehoil shennaasa bo mitzva achat — yesh laasot bo mitzva acheret. Veap al pi shehu yabesh veen recho nodep kol kak, mikkol maqom meriach hu qetzat. Veyesh omerim sheyyoter tob lebarek al shear besamim sheiqqar recham bahem millebarek al hadas yabesh sheen bo ella reach qetzat. Veken nohagin bimdinot ellu. Umikkol maqom, tob lehanniach gam hadas etzel habbesamim shemmebarekim alehem "bore mine besamim" o "bore atze besamim" veyariach bishnehem, veyaaseh kedibre hakkol:

Mi sheeno neheneh mereach, sheen lo chush hareach — lo yebarek al habbesamim keshemmabdil, ella im ken nitkavven lehotzi bene beto haqqetannim hammerichim shehiggiu kebar lechinnuk berakot. Abal eno yakol lebarek bishbil gedolim hammerichim ap sheenam yodeim lebarek beatzman, lepi shebberaka zo hi birkat hannehenin, ubirkat hannehenin en mi sheeno neheneh yakol lebarek bishbil mi shenneheneh, mittaam shennitbaer besimman qs"z. Veeno domeh lebirkat hayyayin shel qiddush shehi gam ken birkat hannehenin veap al pi ken yakol mi sheeno neheneh lebarek, lepi shehayyayin shel qiddush eno taluy bahanaato kelal, shello tiqqenuhu chakamim bishbil hanaat haadam ella bishbil shetztzarik lezakerehu al hayyayin, abal habbesamim bemotzae shabbat lo hinhigu chakamim ella bishbil hanaat haadam, lehashib napsho haddoebet litziat hashshabbat, vahare birkatah kishar birkat hannehenin:

Veken mi shehibdil kebar leatzmo vechozer umabdil lehotzi acherim sheenam yodeim lehabdil beatzmam — lo yebarek lahem al hareach sheyyarichu hem, ella tzarik gam hu lachazor ulehariach immahem, kede shettehe birkato bishbil atzmo velo bishbilam bilbad:

Abal birkat bore meore haesh yakol lebarek lahem ap al pi sheeno tzarik lebarek otah bishbil atzmo, lepi shebbirkat haur lo nitqena bishbil hanaat haadam, ella lezeker shennibra haur bemotzae shabbat, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman rch"tz, lekak enah doma lebirkat hannehenin. Veyesh choleqin al zeh veomirayam sheap shello nitqena bishbil hanaat haadam, mikkol maqom hoil veeno tzarik lechazzer achar haur lebarek alayv bemotzae shabbat kederek shetztzarik lechazzer achar kol hammitzvot shehen choba, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman rch"tz, lepikak en beraka zo doma lebirkat hammitzvot, shemmippene shehen choba yakol lebarek otan mi sheyyatza kebar yede chobato kede lehotzi acherim shello yatzeu adayin yede chobatan, kemo shennitbaer besimman qs"z. Vetob lachush ledibrehem, shello lehikkanes bispeq beraka lebattala:
